clue.text: Save son caught parking on edge

explanation.definitionFit: Insatiate is an older form of insatiable: never satisfied, always craving more.

clue.text: Pulls in listeners across north

clue.text: Volunteers with only daughter having claws

clue.text: Accept a rise and go away

a hike is a rise, as in a price hike

explanation.surface: An employee told to accept a pay rise and then leave.

clue.text: Island group getting central points in arguments

clue.text: Heard result of injury, makes tea

clue.text: Pubs full of unusually clean stickers

clue.text: Son has no trousers

parts.note: if one has no something, one lacks it

explanation.surface: A boy with nothing to wear on his legs.

clue.text: Gather English literature must be rejected as barren

clue.text: Stretch script with no beginning and finish
